info.name: Crypto Wallet
info.description:
Manage multiple cryptocurrency wallets and addresses inside your own Nextcloud. Private keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM in the browser before storage — the server never sees them in plain text.
Features: - AES-256-GCM client-side encryption for private keys - Support for 51 cryptocurrencies including BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, LTC, ADA, and 45 more — searchable combobox for quick selection - Live USD price display and 24h change via CoinGecko - Amount tracking and live portfolio total per wallet - Hide/Show amounts toggle for privacy - Per-wallet password protection with strength indicator - Zero-knowledge architecture — passwords never leave the browser
info.author: Markus Begerow
